lock_owner="'$$

cleanup_lock() {
  if [ -f "$lock_dir/pid" ] && [ "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock_dir/pid")" = "$lock_owner" ]; then
    unlink "$lock_dir/pid"
    rmdir "$lock_dir"
  fi
